tools.name: list_compensationprofessional_feeds
tools.description: List Compensation Professional's free machine-readable feeds and their MCP/REST availability. OpenAPI is also published at https://compensationprofessional.com/openapi.json.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search or list the compensation-focused book library by title/author substring and/or classifier tag. No filters returns the first page.

tools.name: get_library_work
tools.description: Returns one compensation library work's bibliographic record and (when profiled) its thesis.

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Returns one authored /answers page as structured content: question, short answer, problem frame, and citations. Known slugs (14): how-to-set-pay-ranges, what-should-we-pay-for-a-role, is-our-pay-competitive, how-to-tie-executive-pay-to-performance, executive-compensation-components, how-much-executi

tools.name: get_wage_jurisdiction
tools.description: Returns one tracked jurisdiction's current minimum-wage rate, effective date, validation status, and next scheduled step. 113 known jurisdictions, e.g.: federal, alaska, alabama, arkansas.

tools.name: check_wage_locations
tools.description: Checks the binding minimum-wage rate for up to 50 US locations in one call (city/county rate when it applies, else state, else federal). Each location may be a place name ("Spokane, WA", "Texas", "TX") or a jurisdiction slug. A city with no rule of its own on file returns its state's rate with noLoc

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_answer" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
